Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 123. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Make a single combo attack roll against a target of
your choice within range dealing your unarmed strike
damage die on a hit and lowering the AC of the target by
1 for their next 2 rounds. A target cannot be affected by
this or a similar effect from a technique more than once
at a time.
